summary: REQ-106 and REQ-107 appear implemented (gated scheduling, cleanup, 19:00 guard, rate-limited friendly failure toasts). REQ-104 is partially implemented but the notification body string does not match the required curly-apostrophe text. REQ-105 cannot be fully verified from the truncated diff; click handler wiring exists, but focusing and opening the Mark Today sheet / navigating Home is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Notification body must be exactly "You haven’t marked today’s attendance. Tap to update now." (including the curly apostrophe).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows the reminder body uses a straight apostrophe ("haven't") rather than the required curly apostrophe ("haven’t"), so the string does not exactly match acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: Clicking the reminder notification focuses the app window/tab and opens the existing "Mark Today’s Classes" bottom sheet, navigating to Home if needed (works from other tabs).
missing_requirements.reason: While the Notifications API wrapper supports an optional click handler and the reminder hook passes one through, the diff does not provide non-truncated evidence that the click handler actually focuses the window/tab and triggers navigation to Home + opening MarkTodaySheet from any route.
